documents.summary: Tier 4 (university-wide; tiers 1-3 searched, none found): The official UQAT guide for written work tells students to check each course outline and assessment instructions to see whether generative AI is allowed. It lists conditions instructors may impose, such as restricted uses, describing AI use, giving prompts and outputs in an appendix, and signing an intellectual-integrity declaration. Passing off AI output as one's own or having AI do the work counts as a sanctionable fraudulent practice. No computing-specific AI document was public for UQAT's computing-track programs (création numérique profil informatique, jeux vidéo programmation).
